g.text: ASSEMBLY / ELECTRICAL PCB CANDIDATE - PHYSICAL QUALIFICATION REQUIRED
USB-C female / white16x2 LCD / device fingerprint
Fingerprint first; PIN additional, never fallback
Validate preload, retention and independent LCD reset
No battery, shield, screw or plane behind the coil
F.Cu / B.Cu / In2 signals; In1 ground
PCB and enclosure controls checked together.
FP tail left, contacts down; pin1 at lower edge.
Support sensor back; do not clamp the flex bend.
0.50W input budget; cell charge up to0.42W.
No IP rating or physical-attack certificate.
CAD AND SIMULATION ARE ENGINEERING EVIDENCE / QUALIFY BEFORE REAL KEY PROVISIONING
